messages.author: 33fe3608622d7c76
messages.subject: Input files from working directory
parts:
Hi!

Thanks for providing such a great tool! I had one question: I'm trying to upload a subset of files that I have in the same working directory as ui.r and server.r, but I don't want to actually upload all of them (i.e. fileInput). I just want to be able to 'call' certain files and run my scripts using those files. In other words, if I was writing a script outside of Shiny I would do:

setwd("C:/Users/Sarah/Desktop/EAST_CLIMATE/east")

lat.high <- 41.9375
lat.low <- 41.5625
lon.high <- -71.4375
lon.low <- -71.8125

filenames <- list.files("C:/Users/Sarah/Desktop/EAST_CLIMATE/east")
num_site <- length(filenames)
substring(DATA_MIN,6,12)
FILES <- filenames[which(substring(filenames,6,12)>= lat.low & substring(filenames,6,12)<= lat.high & substring(filenames,14,21) >= lon.high & substring(filenames,14,21) <= lon.low)] 

Then I would want to loop through different files of interest. Hope this makes sense! 

I was wondering if that's even possible or how I could do this in the Shiny package. The files are Unix Executable Files. 

Thanks in advance.

-Sarah

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Input files from working directory
parts: If I understand correctly, that would be fine, just eliminate the setwd call at the top and have list.files() look at the "." (current) directory. This is assuming that you're running the Shiny app locally and also have the data files locally.
